p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u089/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ef15ba70.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    full_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] != 0 for c in range(w))]
    if full_rows:
        coords = {r: grid[r][0] for r in full_rows}
        period = len(coords)
        lookup = {r % period: color for r, color in coords.items()}
        return [[lookup[r % period] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    coords = {}
    for r, c, color in cells:
        k = c - r
        if k in coords and coords[k] != color:
            # Keep each parallel stripe identified by its diagonal intercept.
            continue
        coords[k] = color
    period = len(coords)
    lookup = {k % period: color for k, color in coords.items()}
    return [[lookup[(c - r) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p, p.read_text())
